subject: Engagement plan & procurement signature deadline — proposed Nov 10
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Jensen <kyle.jensen@novapay.com>, Alicia Tran <alicia.tran@novapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: engagement plan & proposed close timeline

Thanks for the time today — quick recap and a short engagement plan draft attached.

Key highlights from the call:
- Primary objective: replace batch reconciliation service with Redwood hosted inference to accelerate fraud detection and reduce false positives.
- Expected ramp: 2 models in pilot, production traffic by Nov.

Draft engagement milestones (attached: engagement_plan_v1.xlsx):
1) Legal review & redlines — owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood); target: 2026-10-22
2) Procurement/PO routing — owner: Alicia Tran (NovaPay); target: 2026-10-29
3) Technical integration & test harness — owner: Sean Gallagher (Redwood); target: 2026-11-01
4) UAT & performance validation — owner: Kyle Jensen (NovaPay); target: 2026-11-07
5) Contract signature / go-live target — owner: Kyle/Alicia; proposed target: 2026-11-20

Dependencies called out:
- SOC 2 attestation documents to confirm data handling (we can provide our report and specific controls mapping)
- PO approval window — please confirm internal procurement deadlines
- Any specific data residency or vendor onboarding requirements for NovaPay (let us know if KYC or extra attestations are needed)

Next steps / asks:
- Can you confirm NovaPay's hard procurement signature deadline? If there's a quarter-close constraint, we can re-align milestones.
- Marissa: please expect to receive and review a redlineable SOW (attached: SOW-draft.pdf).
- Sean: I'll ask the engineering team to prepare the integration guide and a short test checklist.

I attached the draft engagement plan and SOW for your review. I can update the plan with the exact signature deadline once you confirm procurement timing.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0168

Attachments: engagement_plan_v1.xlsx (XLSX), SOW-draft.pdf (PDF)

From: Kyle Jensen <kyle.jensen@novapay.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Alicia Tran <alicia.tran@novapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: engagement plan & proposed close timeline

Rachel — thanks for the quick recap and the materials. A few items from procurement here: 

1) Hard procurement signature deadline: our vendor onboarding and Q4 budget cadence mean we need a signed contract by 2026-11-10 at the latest if we want services to be budgeted for November spend. If signature slips past the 10th it will likely push to our December cycle.

2) Legal redlines: we will request a couple of changes around the IP clause and an SLA carve-out for production error budgets. I'll have Alicia route to procurement/legal tomorrow; expect a consolidated redline by 2026-10-14.

3) Data residency: NovaPay requires confirmation of EU data residency for EU cardholders; we currently host in us-west and eu-west — confirmation needed which controls will apply.

Request: can you update the plan to show a target signature of 2026-11-10 and highlight the items that are blockers for that date (legal, PO, SOC report)? Also, if there is any way to compress the technical integration (parallelize work), please note it.

I can be available for a short sync on Thu to confirm owners.

—Kyle
VP, Product Ops | NovaPay
kyle.jensen@novapay.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Jensen <kyle.jensen@novapay.com>, Alicia Tran <alicia.tran@novapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: engagement plan & procurement signature deadline (updated)

Appreciate the heads up, Kyle — thanks. I've updated the engagement plan (attached: engagement_plan_v1-RevA.xlsx) to reflect a revised target signature of 2026-11-10 and called out the blockers. Summary of updates: 

- New target signature: 2026-11-10 (moved from 2026-11-20)
- Blockers for the 11/10 deadline: legal redlines turnaround, finalized PO, SOC 2 evidence delivery
- Adjusted milestones to parallelize work where possible: engineering onboarding and test harness begin immediately on receipt of sample data (target: 2026-10-12) while legal review runs in parallel.

Owner matrix (short):
- Legal / contract redlines — Marissa Cole (Redwood) + NovaPay legal (Alicia to coordinate)
- Procurement / PO — Alicia Tran (NovaPay)
- Technical integration / sandbox access — Sean Gallagher (Redwood) + NovaPay engineering (Kyle)
- UAT & performance sign-off — Kyle Jensen (NovaPay)

Related links: Google Drive (engagement plan), DocuSign envelope (we can prepare once redlines are agreed).

Marissa — can you confirm you'll be able to turn around an initial redline by 2026-10-14? If you need any language templates from our side (IP/SLA exceptions), I can surface them this afternoon.

Alicia/Kyle — if procurement needs an internal PO number or a preferred DocuSign workflow, share that and we'll align.

Next step: propose a 20-minute sync Thursday (2026-10-08) to lock owners and confirm PR/PO path. If that works I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Rachel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: engagement_plan_v1-RevA.xlsx (XLSX)
Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bEngagementPlanNov, https://www.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-NOVAPAY

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 08 Oct 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: engagement plan & procurement signature deadline (technical notes)

Short technical note to make sure the timeline is feasible for a Nov 10 signature + early Nov go-live: 

- We need a sample of NovaPay's event schema and ~7 days to validate model inputs (requesting files by 2026-10-12).
- For a clean cutover we recommend provisioning dedicated capacity on Nov 1 — that gives us two weeks for load/latency tuning before go-live. Please confirm if reserved capacity is acceptable or if you prefer hosted autoscale.
- API key rotation / onboarding: NovaPay will need a short checklist for key permissions; we can send that today.

If NovaPay can deliver schema + CSV samples by 10/12, our engineering team can meet the compressed timeline. Happy to discuss on Thu.

—Sean
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
